extractionMethod: deterministic OOXML parse (styles.xml, document.xml, sectPr) — no ML/LLM involved

namedStylesActuallyUsedInBody.note: grep for w:pStyle in word/document.xml returned ZERO matches. Every paragraph in the document body — including what visually read as section headings (TÓM TẮT, ĐẶT VẤN ĐỀ, KẾT QUẢ, etc.) — carries no pStyle reference at all, meaning it defaults to Normal with direct run-level formatting (bold/italic) applied per-run.
namedStylesActuallyUsedInBody.consequence: This template cannot be represented with a plain string styleMap the way the vn-academic-thesis family can. It requires mapping a block type to a style name PLUS a direct-formatting override (see SCHEMA_PATCH_NOTES.md).

tableStylesUsed.note: auto-generated Word table style names from pasted/inserted tables, not a meaningful shared convention — treat tables as direct-bordered, not style-driven.

directFormattingObservedOnBodyParagraphs.note: Overrides the Calibri 11pt docDefault on essentially every paragraph — the direct override is the real convention in use.
